artifact: Issue #9 M4-3 authorization composition and lease role contract
lease_issuance_role: M4-3 receives an already-issued CapabilityLease; M4-2 CapabilityLeaseIssuer remains the sole issuer boundary.
ingress_may: derive the intent fingerprint from the actual MutationIntent
validate the received lease against actual request bindings
invoke the existing lifecycle transition after validation
ingress_may_not: call CapabilityLeaseIssuer.issue for a model-facing request
choose a project or Subject under ambiguity
treat the lease as durable semantic authority
derive request bindings from lease fields
composition_sequence: M4-2 issuance has already validated exact trusted principal, operation, typed target, scope, descriptor contract, intent fingerprint, Subject precondition, external precondition, and required approval/Decision evidence.
M4-3 resolves the descriptor from the canonical registry and computes its contract hash locally.

M4-3 obtains operation, target, scope, intent fingerprint, Subject revision, external precondition, authority source revision, observed raw digest, candidate raw digest, and normalized plan digest from the actual typed request.
M4-3 calls CapabilityLeaseIssuer.validate_lease with those actual bindings and the trusted context.
M4-3 invokes the lifecycle handler only after lease validation succeeds.
The lifecycle transaction performs its own Subject-rooted authority/CAS checks; the ingress does not replace or weaken them.

evidence_rule.positive_ingress_tests: must obtain a lease from CapabilityLeaseIssuer.issue using a valid TrustedMutationAuthorization
evidence_rule.unknown_outcome_retry: deny before reconciliation; never reuse the original lease blindly
